description: Autocomplete a partial US address. Given a primary-line prefix (and optional city/state/zip), returns up to 10 full address suggestions. Suggestions are candidates, not guaranteed deliverable — verify with lob_verify_address. Example: lob_autocomplete({ address_prefix: "185 B", city: "San Francisco", state: "CA", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your Lob API key (sign up at https://dashboard.lob.com/).

address_prefix.description: Partial primary line to complete, e.g. "185 B".

name: lob_autocomplete
title: Lob Autocomplete
